content: Igaw bigulekwes Yowbad nabunatum
Yeisuw ilisow Yowbad nabunatum, inoun; navamul mo inekes, ikamtilakes Yeisuw bikin Yowbad nabunatum siyas bunamnabweins.
Yeisuw ikatimop ages, ilana, “Kukines bunsiyas bunatum. Mounid adibakeimiy bo bigulekwes biyakousis; dakul babaw bilaves bikatiggayes.”
Mouvit tutan nakabsilamaw ven watinow

Inounas ineis koy towen bigulen oliv nises, isin; tasiyas navamul inekes, ilansa, “Kudibakem asinavin bigulekwes bunatum bunawen bunavakaein; ama̱wan bakakakin avei-tut bukuyum bukum mo beikous ven watinow?”
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Awoum gamag mwasinis bikatidavimiy.

“Igaw teitan bisap, bilana, ‘Yey Mesay Kelis yey,’ wankuyeim tayuwein bisap bilana, ‘Yey Mesay Kelis yey,’ wankuyeim tatounun ma̱wan; e, ma̱wana ma̱wana ee... singay babaw. Tasiyas bo bikatidividavs wasigeis gamag babaw.
“Liva̱nen naviy bukuliganes, livan kweitan kweitan, awoum beiyow nuwamiy, kadiloka biva̱ges ma̱wan; nakabiyokous tut igaw.
“Peinan ven kweitan bikanaviys kweitan ven waseg, ven avakaein bikanaviys ven avakaein waseg; ven mwasanin bikamates moun; ven mwasanin nik avakaein bivag.
“Youd tasiyas moumouvit bisunaps, igaw mo bivakaein.
“Tasiyas ikamliweimiy mo biyagageimiy, bikatimateimiy; e, vena babaw gimgilis bikamliweimiy peinan gungamag yakamiy.
“Mapuna mwasinis bikalouws; mwasinis bisilkodes sisiyas, bikamliwes.
“Palopit siyas mwasanin tayyaweids bisaps, bikatidavis gamag babaw.
“O sinap kalbaleb bo bivakaein, mapuna mo beigwey siwa̱youb wasigeis gamag babaw.
“Kukin kalisiy bikaptules, ee... nakabiyokous tut waseg Yowbad mo bikatinabwes.
“Gungamag igaw mo bikawes liva̱nen Yowbad nakaleiwag, biguyes vena babaw wadaban pwepway, bikatiliganes, mo beikous ven watinow.
Moumouvit anatut

“Kweiboug palopit Daniyel nilivnek teitan nawotet igaw biyableb Yowbad navavag, youd singay kalbaleb waseg. E, igaw yakamiy bukukines towen Yowbad wanbunatum. (Bukuvinis livan towen kadiloka bukukwakins). E, igaw bukukines sinap towen, bukusesus Yudiy, kadiloka kusawls kuneis wa̱koy.
“Magat bukuyeiwas wampwa̱siw, awoum kusiw vayuwein wambunatum wanuwan va̱gan bukukow muwliyoug, awoum. Nuwanaw kusawls.
“Magat bukuwotet wa̱bag, awoum bukuyum bukukow amkweim.
“Tut towen wanakougwaw singay moumouvit bilivatus siyas vinay kakuda̱poms, o siyas vinvanuns.
“Kadiloka kunitougs waseg Yowbad va̱gan awoum bukusawls bulbweilim waseg, o awoum bukusawls Tapwa̱loul waseg.
“Peinan tut singay moumouvit. Nag kweitan tut ivag mouvitan ma̱wana towen, kweiboug nag, igaw tut wanakoug nag.
“Kukin Yowbad nag bigidem moumouvit towen, nag kal son mwamovan bises. Tage Yowbad bo bigidem moumouvit, pinamiy inagamag yakamiy.
“Kukin kal bilivan, ‘Mesay towen-an,’ o bilivan, ‘Mesay towen-one,’ awoum kusimounids waseg.

“Peinan tayyaweids mwasanin bisaps, gamag bidokes Mesay tasiyas; o tayyaweids mwasanin bisaps, gamag mwasanin bidokes palopit tasiyas, bikatimlakays aniyes, mamagina naman mulin Yowbad, va̱gan kid bikatidavis gamag; idokes kid bikatidavis Yowbad nagamag.
“Bo akatiboug nuwamiy sinap towen.
“Kukin gog gamag mwasinis bidibakeimiy, bilansa, ‘Mesay wanawoud nises,’ awoum bukun kukin; awoum. Kukin bilansa, ‘Nises bunatum wanuwan,’ awoum kusimounids.
“Igaw Gimgilitoun yey ba̱yum baw, mamagina mititeilin kavikawn bisap wanuvid bimteil ee... bein wayavat, gamag babaw bikines.
“Avanuy takanig nises, mansiyas bunibwan bikatuyouns bimeis.
Gimgilitoun beiyum beim
“Moumouvit anatut beikous, ka̱las mo bidadub, tibukon-vak bikanig mititeilin, siyas wutun walba̱lab bikalka̱louws, youd siyas wanakaew bo beigwey.
“Mo bukukines aniyag wanakaew yey Gimgilitoun. Ven babaw gimgilis biva̱lams, bikineigs Gimgilitoun yey, bo baw lov waseg, soug guntawtoun o yakawanag avakaein waseg.
“Bwa̱gig biyik avakaein va̱gan guntaka̱yobs bineis bikatiyounis gungamag wanuvid, wa̱yals, wayavat, wabomat, bilisawes vena babaw wadaban pwepway, mo bimekeigs yey.
Yaveinun liva̱nen
“Kabebay nises yaveinun waseg. Kadiloka kuliganes sinapun yaveinun. Bukukin biya̱sus yageivein kweivaw mo bukukwakins wuwal bisilamaw.
“Ma̱wan magin bukukines youd tasiyas mo bukukwakins Gimgilitoun yey basap, mamagina wakoukwed nases.
“Mounid adibakeimiy gamag yakamiy, igaw son mwamovamiy bukusesus, mo bukukines youd siyas babaw.
“Liba̱lab son ven watinow bigulek beikous, tage agulivan nag beikous, nag.
Ta-kal ikakin avei-yam
“Ta-kal ikakin avei-yam o avei-tut, nag; min-liba̱lab na-ikakins; yey nag bakakin; misinaka Tamag ikakin.
“Ma̱wana tutan Now, ma̱wana tutag yey, Gimgilitoun yey.
“Peinan kweiboug anatut yevagam na-ipop ven, gamag ikamkwams, imwamoums, iveivays, Now mo itouw wa̱wag.
“Yam towen na-ikakins ee... kweis mo isap iyagages tasiyas. Ma̱wan magin Gimgilitoun yey ba̱yum bam, gamag nag bikakins avei-tut.
“Tawaw asteiy biwwotets wa̱bag, teitan bakow, teitan bises.
“Vinay asteiy bikanimimayes wit, na̱tan bakow, na̱tan bises.
“Kadiloka kumtakavateimiy, peinan nag kukwakins avei-tut miGuyaw yey mo bam.
“Kadiloka kukwakins sinap towen. Magat tanuwagan bunatum bikakin asinavin boug waseg tavveinaw bisap, bo beikit bimtakavet nabunatum, mata ge tavveinaw ge im iven navavag.
“Ma̱wan-vak yakamiy, kadiloka kwatunags, peinan Gimgilitoun yey ba̱yum, o yakamiy nag kukwakins tutag ba̱yum bam.
Teitan itoukum, teitan igwey
“Tamwey inagamag isek inawotet va̱gan tut babaw bivakamus tasiyas wanbunatum nisesus. Yam katanok katanok inawotet towen. Kavel bitoukum nawotet towen waseg? Adok towen ansinap bwein.
“Igaw natovek beiyum beim, biban nagamag inawotet bwein, bikalin nuwan waseg mtowen; o nagamag towen mo bimwa̱saw.
“Mounid mo bisek nagamag towen nawotet mamagina tanuwagan navavag babaw-wan.

“Kukin gog nagamag ansinap kalbaleb, bilivan, ‘Guntovek bo iyouviy,’ mo bikawegweis won, biwaweiys siney, o beikams bimwamoums siney siyas tamwamoums mo bikabala̱weins, natovek gog igaw mo beim, tutan nag bikakin, bisap, bisibilut, mo bimop ansinap kalbaleb; bilev gamag towen binekes tasiyas tayyaweids, mo bivva̱lams, singay bigeg ninous.
